question: M4: alternatives: trade memory for time at the other end (use more memory to cut ops)
number: Spending more memory only pays if one extra bit of memory (x2 bytes = +1 bit) saves more than half the ops. The time terms that could be bought with memory (twiddle tables, spectra of operands) are at most the transform share; storing spectra (the memory-hungry schedule) was rejected in the r1 lean build for exactly this reason.
notes: Universe cell poseidon-r2|MEM.RULE|MEM|M4. Argument from the rule; r1 lean_r1 trade documented in its note.
